name: 👑 STRONGEST MINER SIMULATOR
desc:
Are you ready to become the strongest of them all?

GUIDE
Dig Through Walls --> Reach World Borders --> Teleport To Higher Worlds --> - Collect Power Ups Hidden Behind The Walls --> Feed Your Mythical Pets And Evolve Them --> Become Stronger!

FAQ
- Experiencing lag? Turn on ‘Fast Mode’ in settings
- Dig terrain walls to gain double the amount of power!
- Become stronger to create bigger area of explosion!
- Dig in higher worlds to gain more power!
- Higher worlds have denser terrains causing your area of explosion to be reduced!
- Upgrade Power Multiplier to train faster!
